## Checklist

- [ ] `mvn -o -q test` is green with no extra flags
- [ ] New product / model / example ships with a smoke test **and** a `docs/` page
- [ ] Benchmark or comparison claims include the harness, seeds and machine
- [ ] No new hard dependency on a GPU, a native library, or an incubator module in `cpu-jit`
- [ ] Reconciles to a reference (closed form / published example / the CPU oracle)
